South West Dekalb As Well.  Protect what your parents worked their asses off for.


Alan Holmes (@oh_HOLMES)

Black American families in the City of Atlanta need to treat inherited property like an asset under attack. Because it is. Taxes, repairs, liens, developers, disputes, and neglect will eat it alive. If the family isn’t organized and locked in, that house is GONE.
